scope: Appendix E Revit worksets and worksharing

sources.title: Revit Worksharing & Collaboration Style Standards
sources.notes: The L6 instruction and workset containment ATS already existed. Round 003 adds machine-readable workset-purpose and session/maintenance/upgrade/recovery fields plus broader conformance coverage. Literal example workset names, fixed maintenance cadence, placeholder role labels, and file-based central/local mechanics remain noncanonical where project configuration differs.

sources.title: JSON – Inventory Capture: “Workset”
sources.notes: Raw inventory-capture evidence is retained as discovery provenance and is not promoted as normative governance.
